paragraphs.text: Which signified the ripeness of their sins, and the readiness of God's judgments.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: There will be none left to mourn for them.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: By stopping the sale of food and necessary things which you have gotten into your own hands, and so cause the poor to spend quickly that little that they have, and at length because of need to become your slaves.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: When the scarcity had come they were so greedy for gain, that they thought the holy day to be a hindrance to them.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: That is, the measure small, and the price great.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: That is, the inhabitants of the land will be drowned, as the Nile drowns many when it overflows.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: In the midst of their prosperity, I will send great affliction.
paragraphs.label: g
paragraphs.anchor: sun to go down at noon

paragraphs.text: By which he shows that they will not only perish in body, but also in soul for lack of God's word, which is the food of it.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: For the idolaters used to swear by their idols, which here he calls their sin: and the papists yet swear by theirs.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: That is, the common manner of worshipping, and the service or religion used there.
